project_type: Monorepo: Vite+React SPA frontend, FastAPI Python backend, Cloudflare Worker edge proxy
build_system: Vite for frontend (build via scripts/build.mjs), pip-compile for backend deps, wrangler for edge worker
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom for frontend (vitest.config.js), pytest for backend (tests/conftest.py)
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend vitest to confirm no regressions. 2. Verify JSON-LD output by examining schema builders in lib/jsonld.js. 3. Check sitemap XML generation in backend seo.py
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node 22, Python 3.11 available. No Docker needed for validation.
contribution_requirements: Bot UA regex must stay aligned across 4 locations (vite.config.js, _worker.js, edge-proxy, backend). SEO meta tags managed via PageMeta.jsx useEffect (not declarative React elements) to avoid hydration mismatch.
key_patterns: 1. JSON-LD schemas built in apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js as pure functions returning @graph arrays. 2. PageMeta.jsx injects head tags imperatively via useEffect to avoid React 19 hydration mismatch. 3. Bot rendering handled by _worker.js (Pages Worker) which proxies to backend /html/ endpoint for crawlers. 4. Sitemaps served from backend /api/v1/seo/ endpoints with 10-min cache. 5. Content hierarchy: Board > Class > Stream > Subject > Chapter > Topic. 6. robots.txt has comment-only Content-Signal directive (ai-input=yes) which is not a real spec.
directory_structure: apps/frontend/src/lib/ - utility modules (jsonld.js). apps/frontend/src/components/seo/ - SEO components. apps/frontend/src/pages/ - route page components. apps/frontend/public/ - static assets (robots.txt, ai.txt, llms.txt). apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - FastAPI route modules. apps/backend/app/services/ - business logic. apps/backend/app/models/ - Beanie/MongoDB models. apps/edge/src/ - Cloudflare Worker source.
